title: The Foam in the Seedling Cellar
story: Deep under the Greenglass Cellar, Frothwither the Spore Bellows huffs and puffs, pumping thick green foam into the room where the village keeps its rescue-seedlings. Mr 6 yanks open the old floor drains, and the foam starts glugging away — but not fast enough to stop it entirely. The tiny seedlings sit on a shelf twelve feet above the foam, and Mr 6 needs to know exactly how long he has to carry them out.
question: Frothwither pumps foam in fast enough to raise it 6 feet every minute, while the open drains pull it down 4.5 feet every minute. If the foam is 12 feet below the seedling shelf, how many minutes does Mr 6 have before the foam reaches the shelf?
solution: The foam rises 6 feet a minute but the drains remove 4.5, so the real rise is 6 - 4.5 = 1.5 feet each minute.
Mr 6 has 8 minutes to rescue the seedlings.
praise: Working with the rise rate was exactly right — the missing step was subtracting the drains first, so the foam only truly gains 1.5 feet a minute.
hint: Foam pours IN and drains OUT at the same time. Find how much the level really gains in one minute before you divide.
victory: Mr 6 marched the last seedling upstairs with thirty seconds to spare, then plugged Frothwither's bellows with a mossy cork. The monster deflated into a polite little puff of green steam and offered to water the garden instead.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape hoisting trays of glowing seedlings above a rising sea of green foam in a lamplit stone cellar, while a bellows-shaped fungus monster puffs frantically in the shadows.
